discord_config_id.description: Control Panel managed Discord Bot Config. Required when stream-specific Discord guild/channel overrides are provided.

discord_guild_id.description: Stream-specific Discord guild override. Valid only with discord_config_id.

discord_voice_channel_id.description: Stream-specific Discord voice channel override. Valid only with discord_config_id.

discord_text_channel_id.description: Optional stream-specific Discord text channel override. Valid only with discord_config_id.

auto_start_trigger.description: Set to discord_voice_join to allow this waiting stream to start automatically when a user joins the configured Discord voice channel. Empty or omitted disables automatic start.
